# Undo Close where what closed can't come back (in liberttyd: --persist).
# A pane closed in one workspace, Undo pressed from another: its program
# ends then, not runs on in liberttyd where no window shows it.
workspace:new:Temp
expect-workspace:=Default [Temp]
key:cmd+d
wait:0.8
type:sleep 31337
key:enter
wait:0.8
action:close_surface
wait:0.6
sheet:Close
wait:0.8
expect-panes:1
expect-shell:pgrep -f 'sleep 3133[7]' >/dev/null && echo STILL-RUNNING ==> STILL-RUNNING
workspace:1
expect-workspace:=[Default] Temp
undo:go
wait:1.0
expect-shell:pgrep -f 'sleep 3133[7]' >/dev/null || echo ENDED ==> ENDED
